name: Tansaikigou -sec life, monochrome cube-
original_name: 単彩綺劫-sec life, monochrome cube-
source:
Main character's parents get killed on the Christmas night by some red shadow. Eleven years later a wave of mysterious murders occurs at the town. All the witnesses can only say that killer just disappears in the air. Main character already knows by his past memory that the murders are caused by a vampire. He takes a sword and stands on the path of revenge. Mysterious girls join him in this quest.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣诞之夜，主人公的父母遭一道红色黑影杀害。十一年后，小镇接连发生离奇命案。所有目击者都只能说，凶手在眼前凭空消失。凭借过去的记忆，主人公早已知道这些杀人事件出自吸血鬼之手。他拿起长剑，踏上复仇之路。几名神秘少女也加入了这场征途。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
